explanations: Get checks the cache, releases the lock, and then calls the loader. When an entry is missing or expired, every goroutine that arrives before the first load finishes sees the same miss and calls the provider itself, so the provider takes one request per caller (a cache stampede). The fix records an in-flight load per key: the first caller becomes the loader, and later callers wait on its done channel and share its result. The in-flight entry is removed once the load finishes, and only successful results are cached, so an error is shared with the waiters but retried on the next call.
